# New-ZbxProxyData

## SYNOPSIS

Builds a proxy data request without sending it.

## SYNTAX

```
New-ZbxProxyData [-ProxyName] <string> [-Session] <string> [[-History] <ZabbixProxyHistoryItem[]>] [-More] [-ProxyDelay <long>] [-Version <Version>] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The New-ZbxProxyData cmdlet builds the proxy data request an active proxy sends the server: the proxy's name, a session token, and the history values in -History, from New-ZbxHistoryValue or New-ZbxHistoryDataEntry. It writes the request for inspection, or for a send a script makes itself; Send-ZbxProxyData builds and sends one in a single step. Nothing is sent to the server.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Build a proxy data request

```powershell
New-ZbxProxyData -ProxyName 'proxy-01' -Session ([guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')) | Select-Object Request, Host, Session, Version, Clock
```

The 'proxy data' request an active proxy sends, built locally for inspection; nothing is sent. -Session is the 32-hex-digit token the server de-duplicates history on (a new GUID without dashes is one).

### Example 2: Wrap history values in the request

```powershell
$item = Get-ZbxItem -Host 'web-01' | Where-Object Key -eq 'app.requests'
$history = 1..3 | ForEach-Object { New-ZbxHistoryDataEntry -ItemId $item.ItemId -Value (10 * $_) }
(New-ZbxProxyData -ProxyName 'proxy-01' -Session ([guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')) -History $history).History |
    Select-Object Id, ItemId, Value
```

-History takes entries from New-ZbxHistoryDataEntry; the request carries them as its 'history data' array.

### Example 3: Describe a backlog and the protocol version

```powershell
New-ZbxProxyData -ProxyName 'proxy-01' -Session ([guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')) -More -ProxyDelay 120 -Version '7.0.0' |
    Select-Object Host, More, ProxyDelay, Version
```

-More (another page follows at once) and -ProxyDelay (age of the oldest value still held, in seconds) are how a proxy that fell behind reports; -Version is the protocol version announced (7.4.0 by default).

## INPUTS

None.

## OUTPUTS

- `ZabbixProxyDataRequest`: proxy data: a page of history, discovery, auto-registration, interface availability and task results — or, with every list empty, the probe a held proxy sends, which carries no history data key because a server with uploads disabled refuses any request that has one.
